mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite a positive and statistically significant GDPC1 growth trend (t-test p < 0.05) over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (industrial production) signals reduced supply-side uncertainty, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns show no significant positive correlation with INDPRO growth (p > 0.05 in OLS) or rank IC < 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% per annum, investors anticipate tighter monetary policy, causing short-term equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% but SPX 5d returns are positive (p < 0.05 in t-test) or rank IC > 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in UNRATE (unemployment) signals conflicting policy signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE move in tandem without negative returns (p > 0.05 in regression) or rank IC > 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE <4%), a rise in FEDFUNDS triggers investor fears of over-tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains ≥4% or FEDFUNDS do not rise when expected, or SPX 60d returns are positive (p <0.05) despite the regime conditions.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST crosses above 2000 units, indicating heightened household demand, S&P 500 forward returns become positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST crosses above 2000 but SPX 5d returns are negative (p >0.05 in t-test) or rank IC <0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) reduces market uncertainty, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL decline reverses or SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (p >0.05 in OLS) over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDPC1 (GDP growth) and INDPRO (industrial production) rise simultaneously, it signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise but SPX 20d returns are negative (p >0.05 in regression) or rank IC <0.05 over the horizon.
